FAMILY 08 · 病理基础模型：从 patch encoder 到 whole-slide 多模态推理Pathology Foundations

PRISM2

PRISM2 明确提供双嵌入：Perceiver 的通用 base embedding，以及 Phi-3 隐状态导出的诊断 embedding。

Pairs a Perceiver slide encoder over Virchow2 tile embeddings with a Phi-3 LLM trained on single-turn clinical dialogues derived from pathology reports, exposing dual embeddings.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 一个病例的一张或多张 H&E WSI、文本提示与由报告改写的单轮临床对话 Multi-slide H&E case tile embeddings (Virchow2) + clinical prompt / diagnostic query
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 2560 维 base embedding、3072 维 diagnostic embedding、报告或问答文本 2560-D base slide embedding, 3072-D LLM diagnostic embedding, or autoregressive pathology text response

MATHEMATICAL FORMALISM
核心公式 · PRISM2 基础嵌入与诊断嵌入的双接口
Core Formalism · Dual-Interface Perceiver Base Slide Embedding & Phi-3 Diagnostic Hidden-State Embedding
01 // PRIOR LIMITATION
上一代瓶颈

两阶段 patch/slide/LLM 管线信息瓶颈多且难统一适配

Two-stage MIL + LLM pathology pipelines suffered from rigid task heads and disconnected visual vs. linguistic representations.

02 // CORE HYPOTHESIS
核心想法

将 Virchow2 tile embeddings 输入 Perceiver slide encoder，再连接 Phi-3 进行临床对话式推理

Connect a Perceiver slide aggregator to a clinical LLM (Phi-3) via conversational report supervision, extracting both visual and LLM-contextualized embeddings.

03 // ARCHITECTURAL DELTA
关键改进

第一阶段训练 slide encoder，第二阶段冻结它并训练语言接口与 prompt-based inference

Exposes dual reusable interfaces (Perceiver base embedding + LLM last-token diagnostic embedding) alongside promptable zero-shot inference.

04 // MEDICAL TRANSLATION
医学适配

以临床对话作为监督和病理全切片推理接口，不以部署聊天代理为目标

Designed as a promptable whole-slide diagnostic representation and conversational reasoning engine rather than a patient-facing chatbot.

05 // EVIDENCE & BOUNDARY
适用范围与证据

新近前沿；需要独立复现、病理医生盲评和部署安全证据

Emerging 2025/2026 frontier preprint; requires independent multi-center replication and pathologist workflow validation.

ARCHITECTURAL AXIOMS // 设计原理与数学机制
  • Virchow2 负责局部 tile，Perceiver 把超长序列压成可迁移 base embedding。
  • Stage 1 让同一 slide 表示同时满足 BioGPT 对比对齐与 Phi-3 自回归生成。
  • Stage 2 冻结 slide encoder，仅用报告改写的单轮临床对话强化 prompt-based inference。
  • Core Hypothesis: Connect a Perceiver slide aggregator to a clinical LLM (Phi-3) via conversational report supervision, extracting both visual and LLM-contextualized embeddings.
  • Architectural Delta: Exposes dual reusable interfaces (Perceiver base embedding + LLM last-token diagnostic embedding) alongside promptable zero-shot inference.
  • Mathematical Formalism: Dual-Interface Perceiver Base Slide Embedding & Phi-3 Diagnostic Hidden-State Embedding.
CLINICAL TRANSLATION & BOUNDARIES // 医学应用与安全边界
  • base embedding 更适合 biomarker、生存等迁移；diagnostic embedding 更偏癌症诊断语义。
  • 临床对话是丰富监督形式，不表示模型被设计为多轮部署聊天代理；生成输出仍可能错误。
  • Clinical Translation: Designed as a promptable whole-slide diagnostic representation and conversational reasoning engine rather than a patient-facing chatbot.
  • Evidence & Safety Boundary: Emerging 2025/2026 frontier preprint; requires independent multi-center replication and pathologist workflow validation.
